tools.name: plan_trips
tools.description: Generate cheap round trips through several cities, from cached flights. Accepts one departure city (from) or up to 5 (from_cities); with several, a trip can return to a different one of them. Returns trips sorted by total price. To share or book a trip, pass its flight_ids to save_trip.

from.description: Departure city name, exactly as returned by search_cities. Give from or from_cities.

from_cities.description: Several departure cities (up to 5), exactly as returned by search_cities. A trip leaves from one of them and may return to any of them.

legs.description: Number of outbound flights before the flight home (1-7). The round trip adds one flight home, so the trip has legs+1 flights total.

min_nights.description: Minimum nights in each city, default 2.

max_nights.description: Maximum nights in each city, default 3.

include_countries.description: Only visit cities in these ISO country codes.

exclude_countries.description: Never visit cities in these ISO country codes.

limit.description: Maximum number of trips to return, default 5, max 10.

tools.name: save_trip
tools.description: Save a trip from flight ids returned by search_flights or plan_trips. Returns a public page with the trip and a booking link on Kiwi.com. Prices are confirmed on the booking site.

flight_ids.description: Flight ids from search_flights or plan_trips, in any order, at least 1 and at most 8.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Find city names we have flights for. Use the exact name in the other tools.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Cheapest one-way flights between two cities, or from one city to anywhere. Dates are a departure window; a specific destination is checked against the airlines live when its prices are missing.

from.description: Departure city name, exactly as returned by search_cities.

to.description: Arrival city name; omit to search anywhere.

date_to.description: Latest departure date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to date_from.

limit.description: Maximum number of flights to return, default 20, max 50.
